completed_steps: Surveyed repo structure, AGENTS.md/PRODUCT.md, git log, and docs/superpowers/plans and specs

Discovered prior session already ran a full matching-quality audit and landed a real code fix for problem #1 (gender/portrait mismatch) — see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-04-matching-quality-phase1.md and commits 993af1c..f5fc3f5

Discovered prior session already fixed a real root cause behind part of problem #3 (non-English retrieval) — supabase/language-pool-fix-migration.sql, commit 5375bce: HNSW index caused ANN search to run before the language WHERE filter, starving minority languages

Traced problem #2 (explicit text request e.g. 'french vibe' ignored) to root cause and FIXED it: lib/vibeIntent.ts's extractRequestedLanguage(), wired into app/api/recommend/route.ts to override taste.languages/languageOpenness when present, wired into app/app/page.tsx to actually send vibeIntent to /api/recommend (previously only sent to /api/analyze).

Traced problem #4 (onboarding flash for returning logged-in users) to root cause and FIXED it: app/app/page.tsx's effectiveShowOnboarding used `tasteComplete !== true`, which conflates 'still loading' (null) with 'confirmed incomplete' (false) — changed to `tasteComplete === false`. Also fixed a real latency contributor in lib/useAccountSync.ts: /api/migrate-local was awaited before /api/taste on EVERY login; now skipped via a local 'migratedLocalData' flag after the first successful run on a given device.

CRITICAL, empirically confirmed via real Supabase calls: supabase/pov-signal-migration.sql was NOT applied to production despite the code being merged — a real update_song RPC call failed with PGRST202, meaning song catalog writes (admin edits, auto-tagging) were actively broken, not just the POV penalty being inert. User ran the migration; re-verified live (column exists, RPC accepts the param, catalog writes work again).

User approved and ran the lyrical_address backfill for the full existing catalog. Hit a real infra incident mid-run (a zombie dev-server process with a broken stdout pipe crash-looped Turbopack workers and took real API routes down as collateral damage) — diagnosed, killed every stale process, restarted clean, resumed, and completed: 2583/2583 songs classified, 0 errors, verified via a live exact-count query.

Ran three real GPT-4o vision calls (golden-hour.jpg, happiness.jpg, blinding-lights.jpg — the app's own marketing assets) against the live BASE_SYSTEM_PROMPT to empirically verify presentationRead: correctly read 'female' for both female-presenting photos and 'neutral' (not a guessed gender) for a no-person night-drive photo — protecting the 'landscapes/night photos already work well' baseline from the original ask. Then ran real computePovPenalty math against real classified catalog songs (3 male-lyrical-address songs correctly got -25 penalty, 3 female + 2 neutral songs correctly got 0). Problem #1 confirmed working end-to-end with real data, not just at the unit-test level.

USER OVERRODE the initial 'era preference' design recommendation for #3b and explicitly directed: ask age directly, derive generation from it, and build the full pipeline off that — implemented accordingly (see below), not the originally-recommended non-PII 'era preference' framing.

Built problem #3b (age/generation matching) end-to-end, mirroring the exact architecture already proven for #1 (POV signal): lib/tagTaxonomy.ts Generation type + coerceGeneration (6 values: gen-z/millennial/gen-x/boomer/timeless/unclear); UserTaste.generation field (lib/matching.ts, lib/db/userTaste.ts, lib/taste/importSongs.ts); new AgeStep.tsx onboarding step (age-range buttons mapped to a generation, inserted as step 2 of 5, wired into OnboardingFlow.tsx + en.ts/ru.ts translations); supabase/generation-preference-migration.sql (user_taste.generation, main project, direct table access) and supabase/song-generation-migration.sql (songs.song_generation, catalog project, mirrors pov-signal-migration.sql's 9-function RPC update exactly); song_generation wired through lib/db/songs.ts, lib/autoTag.ts (GPT classification at tag time + backfill-only classifyGeneration()), a new admin classify-generation route, and scripts/backfill-song-generation.mjs; computeGenerationPenalty in lib/recommend.ts (ordinal cohort-distance penalty: 0 for adjacent generations or timeless/unclear, -20 for distance>=2) wired into RecommendRequest/ScoreComponents/scoring and app/api/recommend/route.ts.

Caught and fixed a real regression while adding tests: lib/matching.ts's new coerceGeneration import broke tests/matching.test.mjs's standalone VM test harness (it used the real Node `require`, which resolved './tagTaxonomy' against the test file's directory, not lib/matching.ts's — a real MODULE_NOT_FOUND at runtime, not a hypothetical). Fixed the harness itself (matchingRequire helper that loads the real tagTaxonomy.ts module) rather than avoiding the import — verified by running the test file directly before and after.

Added tests for the generation feature: tagTaxonomy.test.mjs (coerceGeneration + GENERATIONS), recommend.test.mjs (computeGenerationPenalty unit tests + buildRecommendations wiring), matching.test.mjs (normalizeTaste generation coercion), autoTag.test.mjs (prompt/parse/classifyGeneration mirroring the lyrical_address tests), new tests/generationWiring.test.mjs (source-level wiring across OnboardingFlow -> /api/recommend -> lib/recommend.ts).

Final verification: npm test = 309 pass / 1 fail (same single pre-existing, unrelated failure in tests/playlistImportUi.test.mjs that existed before this session started), npx tsc --noEmit -p . clean.

Pushed all code changes to GitHub (origin/main, commits df31823, 02480f5, 60d00ff) at user's explicit request. Excluded supabase/pro-subscription-migration.sql from the push — it has stray garbage text ('юю' + a lone backslash) appended locally, unrelated to any of this session's work; left uncommitted and flagged to the user rather than pushed or silently discarded.

First migration-apply attempt for song-generation-migration.sql failed (user ran it, got PGRST 42703 'column story_context_tags does not exist' at the exact line matching the list_catalog function) — diagnosed as very likely a wrong-project mixup (main project vs catalog project) since a live check confirmed story_context_tags genuinely exists on the real catalog project's songs table.

User re-ran both migrations. Verified all 5 real checks live: (1) user_taste.generation exists (main project), (2) songs.song_generation exists (catalog project), (3) update_song RPC accepts p_song_generation without error, (4) list_catalog RPC returns song_generation, (5) match_songs_by_language RPC returns song_generation. Both #3b migrations confirmed genuinely applied and working.

User approved running the song_generation backfill. Ran cleanly against the already-running dev server with zero infra issues this time (no repeat of the earlier zombie-process incident): 2583/2583 songs classified, 0 errors. Verified via live exact-count queries (not the script's self-report): total 2584 songs, 0 unclassified. Real distribution: gen-z 1841, millennial 234, timeless 243, unclear 261, gen-x 2, boomer 3 — flagged to user that gen-x/boomer coverage is extremely thin (5 songs total), so the generation penalty will have little to act on for older users specifically; this is a catalog-content gap, not a mechanism bug.
